name: Uganda

flag.description: Six horizontal stripes of black, yellow, red, black, yellow and red, with a white disc in the centre showing a grey crowned crane facing the hoist.
flag.symbolism: Black represents the people, yellow the sunshine and red brotherhood; the grey crowned crane is the national bird.

hook: Uganda repeats black-yellow-red twice and puts a grey crowned crane, one leg raised, in a white circle in the middle.
trivia: The crane is shown with one leg raised, often said to symbolise the country moving forward.
Bwindi Impenetrable National Park is home to about half of the world's mountain gorillas.
